true_answer: Small traditional businesses in India start the ﬁscal year on Diwali festival and end the day before the next year's Diwali festival. In accounting (and particularly accounting soware), a ﬁscal calendar (such as a 4/4/5 calendar) ﬁxes each month at a speciﬁc number of weeks to facilitate comparisons from month to month and year to year. January always has exactly 4 weeks (Sunday through Saturday), February has 4 weeks, March has 5 weeks, etc.
